name: Kaze no Oka Kouen nite
source:
Love comes with the Autumn. School idol suddenly confesses to the main character. During the next 17 days he will need to decide which of four girls to give preference and spend unforgettable season with.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-september-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
秋天带来爱情。学校偶像突然向主人公告白。在接下来的17天里，他必须决定选择四名女孩中的哪一位，并与她共度难忘的季节。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-september-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
